hook: Ek query, das counts: SQL ki [[multitasking]]

slides.title: Problem [[kya]] hai?
slides.note: Ek hi query mein sab nikal sakte ho, chill karo

slides.title: Trick: [[CASE]] andar
points: Har row pe CASE: match → **1**, warna **0**

slides.title: Ek query, [[kai metrics]]
slides.code:
SELECT dept,
  SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Delhi'
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    AS delhi_people,
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept;
slides.note: Ye pattern har **dashboard / report** ka favourite hai 📊

slides.title: [[Result]] dekho
slides.note: HR mein Delhi wala koi nahi → **0** aaya, NULL nahi ✓

slides.title: Aur [[metrics]] jodo
slides.note: THEN mein 1 ki jagah **column** do → conditional total 💰

slides.right:
SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Delhi'
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
slides.why: Group mein ek bhi match nahi → SUM = **NULL**, 0 nahi 😵
